rollback_evidence: G81 (XE-M028), measured on IOL-L2 XE 17.18.2 (switch) in the GNS3 lab, task netops-20261118-499-r2 (task-evidence/g81). Key: a physical Ethernet port; create = the port joins a channel-group, update = another LACP mode or another group, delete = the port leaves its group. Lines: 'interface PORT', 'channel-group N mode active|passive' (N 1-48 on this image; a missing port-channel is created by IOS, 'Creating a port-channel interface Port-channel N'); the same group with another mode is changed in place; another group is refused by IOS until 'no channel-group' (without a number) unbundles the port, so a move is 'no channel-group' then the new line; a port-channel left without members and without own configuration lines is removed with 'no interface Port-channelN' (it would also remove the membership of every other member, so it is sent only when no other member exists). PAgP and static modes (on, auto, desirable) and channel-protocol lines are outside the profile. The safeguard is the revert timer of the interface profile. Refused before any write: a trunk or routed port, a port with an address, a routed or management port-channel, the management interface or VLAN, a port with an LLDP/CDP neighbor, learned MAC addresses or a port state other than down in its port-channel. The check account (privilege 1) reads show interfaces PORT etherchannel.
